title: Community Rule: Qimron translation, Library of Congress
access: Selected exhibition translation read; linked display identifies 4Q258/4QSd. This is not a new translation or collation of the complete 1QS scroll.

title: Community Rule artifact and context, Library of Congress
access: Exhibition account identifies the particular fragment and describes admission, conduct and righteous/wicked distinctions. Artifact and complete composition are not interchangeable.

title: Devorah Dimant, Pesharim, Qumran
access: Author-written encyclopedia entry consulted for the identification of Seekers of Smooth Things and the locators 4QpNah 3-4 i 7 and ii 8. An interpretive identification, not an explicit modern party name in the scroll.

title: Etka Liebowitz, Hypocrites or Pious Scholars?
access: Publisher bibliographic record and author-posted abstract consulted, not the complete article. The comparison includes Matthew, Josephus, Pesher Nahum and rabbinic polemic. No assertion of ancient literary dependence is taken from the abstract.

title: Matthew 23, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read, especially 23:2-3,23,27-28. Narrative speech and modern historical attribution are separate questions.

title: Mark 3, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read, especially 3:4-6. The plot is attributed to particular narrative actors, not to all Jews.

title: Luke 13, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read: 13:1-5 concerns victims and repentance; 13:31 records Pharisees warning Jesus about Herod.

title: Didache, chapters 1 and 5, early Christian text in translation
access: Translated Two Ways passages read. The work is distinct from the Gospels and from the Qumran texts; this is not a new critical-edition collation.

title: Mishnah Yoma, Posen Library translation
access: The selected translated text of 8:6-7 consulted for urgent feeding and life-saving exceptions. Ancient treatment descriptions are not current medical guidance.

title: Jeffrey C. Blutinger, So-called Orthodoxy: The History of an Unwanted Label
access: Publisher extract and bibliographic record read, not the complete article. Used for the contested nineteenth-century label, not to reconstruct all Pharisaic-rabbinic continuity.

title: Israelite Samaritan Information Institute: religion
access: Community account consulted for Samaritan self-understanding, Torah and sacred place. Its self-description is recorded respectfully, not treated as a neutral adjudication of every rival claim.

title: Israelite Samaritan Information Institute: prophets
access: Community account read for Moses and Taheb. No claim is made that every individual Samaritan uses an identical formulation.

title: John 4, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read. Gerizim/Jerusalem discussion, 4:22 and spirit/truth language are considered together.

title: Exodus 18, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read for deliverance, shared sacrifice and Jethro correcting Moses's administration.

title: Deuteronomy 8, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read for wilderness hunger and the later temptation to treat wealth as self-produced independence.

title: Matthew 4, World English Bible
access: Translated temptation narrative read. A self-formation interpretation is proposed, not represented as an ancient neuroscience claim.

title: 1 Samuel 15:3-9, King James Version
access: Published biblical translation consulted for the command including infants and the warning that exempts Kenites. The attribution to God is a feature of the text, not an ethical conclusion endorsed by this study.

title: Micah 3, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read for violence, corrupt judgment and the appeal to divine presence despite wrongdoing.

title: Isaiah 58, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read for the critique of fasting combined with oppression and for material care and repair.

title: Isaiah 14, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read. The taunt is addressed to Babylon's king; 14:21 is also retained as a counterexample to portraying the entire book as free of collective-violence language.

title: Daniel 11, World English Bible
access: Translated chapter read, especially 11:36-39. God of fortresses is not silently identified with Apollo or a later demiurge.

title: Revelation 9, NABRE / USCCB
access: Translated chapter and notes consulted for the Abaddon/Apollyon passage. Shared-looking names do not alone prove identity with Apollo or Yaldabaoth.

title: Apocryphon of John, Marvin Meyer translation
access: Relevant indexed translation passages retrieved; direct full-page retrieval failed in this pass. Used only for the limited ruler's ignorance of his origin and borrowed power, not a new manuscript collation.

title: The Reality of the Rulers / Hypostasis of the Archons
access: Translated passage retrieved through this mirror, including correction from above. No complete critical-text or manuscript comparison performed.

title: Ptolemy, Letter to Flora
access: Full online translation read. Its distinction among perfect Father, intermediate lawgiver and adversary is not collapsed into a universal Gnostic doctrine.

title: IPC Gaza assessment and projection, released July 23, 2026
access: Official HTML summary read. Observed assessment: April 16-June 30. Projection: July 1-December 31. No new PDF/table analysis or independent household survey performed.

title: OCHA Humanitarian Situation Report, titled September 4, 2026
access: Full HTML report consulted. The page displays September 8 publication metadata; the Gaza reporting interval is August 24-30 except explicitly dated updates. West Bank incidents are not relabeled Gaza.

title: WHO and partner agencies: famine confirmed in Gaza
access: Joint institutional account consulted for the August 2025 Gaza Governorate famine confirmation. This historical classification is not presented as a fresh September 2026 assessment.

title: IPC December 2025 update
access: Official update consulted for the later change in famine conditions following the October ceasefire; not substituted for the July 2026 assessment.

title: WFP: funding shortfall and assistance reductions
access: Official September 1 statement read. It distinguishes a West Bank coverage cut from an earlier Gaza cash-assistance reduction. The latter documents funding pressure, not a finding that access restrictions are harmless.

title: ICRC Customary IHL Database, Rule 53
access: Rule text retrieved from the indexed official entry; direct site rendering requires JavaScript. Used for the prohibition of civilian starvation as a method of warfare, not a legal judgment concerning a particular person.

title: AFP: Israel rejects August 2025 IPC report
access: Contemporaneous report of the Israeli rejection consulted. Records the government's position; it is not an independent nutritional assessment or a rebuttal established by this study.

title: Reuters: Netanyahu and distinct right-wing electoral partners
access: Contemporaneous report consulted to verify the prime minister and distinguish parties and constituencies. The article is not used as proof of motives shared by all Orthodox Jews.
